title: Edit distance between words
prompt: Read lines from standard input; each line holds two strings separated by a single `|` (either of them may be empty, neither contains `|`). For each line print the Levenshtein distance between them: the fewest single-character insertions, deletions and substitutions that turn the first string into the second. Comparison is case-sensitive and every character counts, spaces included. Lines without exactly one `|` print `invalid`.

cases.name: hidden2
cases.stdin:
Sunday|Saturday
sunday|Sunday
a b|ab
  |
a||b
abc|def|ghi
